title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
什么？！这傻子刚打完电话，万盛集团就通知合作了？！一众人神色霎时僵硬下来，震惊看向明川！就连冷希也有几分不自然。只有冷老爷子的面上绽出笑容，激动得上前一把拉住了明川的手，重重的拍了两下：“好孩子，不愧是我的孙婿！有出息！”明川谦虚的笑了两声：“不客气，当送您的礼物了……”“不可能！”孙韶华忽地打断两人的对话，冷嗤出声：“你肯定是招了临时演员，随时配合你！万盛国际岂是你这种乡下狗能联系得上的？！”此话一出，刚才神经紧绷的众人全都松懈了下来，嘲讽声登时一浪高过一浪。“看老爷子那激动的样子，我差点都被带偏了。”“哈哈哈……冷希，你未婚夫真是……为了充面子，什么事都能干啊？”“太搞笑了，就这种人老爷子竟然也看得上？不知道的人还以为咱们冷家是要破产了，老爷子提前给自己孙女找个土包子，以免她之后没人要呢。”……周遭的嘲讽哄笑声接连不断。冷希不由拳头紧握，眼神冷冽的朝着那几个亲戚横扫过去！霎时，那些家伙立马无趣的收敛起了自己的笑容。明川嘴角抽搐了两下，无语道：“一群没眼界的玩意儿，给你们机会都不中用。”要知道，若能成功合作，这些亲戚也多少能跟着喝点肉汤。可本已消停的众人，闻言再次全场哄堂大笑！冷希脸都僵了。他吹牛怎么从来不打草稿？她叱咤风云这么多年，还从来没这么丢人过！冷希忍无可忍，黑着脸暗自猛拽了明川的衣角一把：“你别开口了！”“行了。”冷老爷子倏地开口打断众人的嘲讽之音，面上带着几分愠怒。“今天是我的寿宴，你们要是不想呆在这，大可以现在就滚出去。”老爷子语气并不重，可明眼人都瞧得出来，他这是怒了。众人立马都闭上了嘴，任由那任晓兰三人如何不悦，也不敢再忤逆老爷子半分。眼见着老爷子转身重回宴桌。

冷晓月挽住孙韶华，轻蔑地冲冷希露出一个挑衅的笑容，转身就要落座，准备继续给老爷子祝寿。可不曾想，此时，别墅之外忽地传来一声巨响。“轰——！”“砰！”一个原本守在别墅门前的保安直接被扔飞到寿宴桌前！众人诧异的朝前定睛一看，只见这保安被打得鼻青脸肿，连叫都叫不出来就晕过去了！接着，一道粗犷的笑声从外面传来。“哈哈哈，冷老爷子，怎么您七十大寿都不叫兄弟们一块来热闹热闹啊？！”来者肩上扛着一根棒球棍，嘴里叼根香烟，臂膀与胸膛纹着一整条狰狞的青龙，整体形象俨然一个络腮胡大汉！在他身后，还跟着十来个同等形象的壮汉！老爷子一看，登时惊诧：“你们是谁？来干什么的？！”那男人冷笑一声，看向孙韶华，“我们今天是来找人还债的，恐怕要打搅一下老爷子你的寿宴了。”他那眼中的威胁之意，让刚才一众嚣张嘲讽明川的人，都变得怂了几分。但同时，众人心中都涌出一股疑惑。冷家谁会欠这种黑道混混的钱？谁也不差那三瓜两枣啊！而这时，除明川之外，没有人注意到，那先前跋扈的孙韶华，在看见壮汉的那一刻，就悄然朝着后方缓慢退去。明川内心暗笑。刚才那装比哥，怕是要翻车咯。任晓兰自诩长辈，端着范儿站出来，“你们这是搞错了吧……”“砰！”壮汉理都没理他，随手抄起一根凳子朝着孙韶华离开的方向砸去，把他边上那桌菜砸得稀烂！“狗东西，你想跑哪去啊？”随着男人一声话落，身后十几个壮汉立马冲上前，将孙韶华的去路堵得死死的，没有一丝缝隙！孙韶华面上登时出现几分惊慌。他连忙快速掩下自己的惶恐，转身扬起一个微笑，朝着男人笑道：“黄哥……您怎么有空来这啊？”黄哥吊儿郎当的扛着棍子走上前，捏着孙韶华那张小白脸，连拍了几下。“那要问问你啊？”
content_en:
What?!As soon as this idiot made the call, Wansheng Group notified him of cooperation?!The expressions of everyone suddenly stiffened and they looked at Mingchuan in shock!Even Leng hope felt a little unnatural.Only Mr. Leng had a smile on his face. He was so excited that he stepped forward and took Mingchuan's hand, and patted it twice: "Good boy, he is indeed my grandson-in-law! He has a lot of potential!" Mingchuan smiled modestly: "You're welcome, I'll give it to you as a gift..." "No way!" Sun ShaoHua suddenly interrupted the conversation between the two and sneered coldly: "You must have hired extras to cooperate with you at any time! How can Wansheng International be contacted by a country dog like you?!" As soon as these words came out, everyone who had been tense before relaxed and the sarcasm suddenly became louder and louder."Looking at the old man's excitement, I almost got carried away." "Hahaha... Leng Xi, your fiancé is really... willing to do anything to save face?" "It's so funny that the old man can like this kind of person? People who don't know think that our Leng family is about to go bankrupt. The old man found a bumpkin for his granddaughter in advance so that no one will want her later."... The ridicule and laughter from around him continued.Leng hope couldn't help clenching her fists, and glanced at those relatives with cold eyes!In an instant, those guys immediately suppressed their smiles.The corner of Mingchuan's mouth twitched twice, and he said speechlessly: "A bunch of visionless things, they will give you no chance." You know, if the cooperation can be successful, these relatives can also drink some broth.But everyone who had already calmed down burst into laughter again after hearing this!Leng hope's face froze.Why is he bragging that he never drafts?She has been in the spotlight for so many years, but she has never been so embarrassed!Leng Xi couldn't bear it anymore, and with a dark face, she secretly tugged on the corner of Mingchuan's clothes: "Stop talking!" "Okay." Mr. Leng spoke quickly to interrupt everyone's sarcasm, with a bit of sullenness on his face."Today is my birthday party. If you don't want to stay here, you can get out now." The old man's tone was not serious, but anyone with a discerning eye could see that he was angry.Everyone immediately shut their mouths, no matter how displeased Ren Xiaolan and the other three were, they did not dare to disobey the old man any more.Seeing the old man turn around and return to the banquet table.

Leng Xiaoyue held Sun Shaohua's arm, gave Leng hope a provocative smile disdainfully, turned around and was about to sit down, ready to continue congratulating the old man on his birthday.Unexpectedly, at this moment, a loud noise suddenly came from outside the villa."Boom——!" "Bang!" A security guard originally guarding the door of the villa was thrown directly to the birthday banquet table!Everyone looked forward in surprise and saw that the security guard had been beaten so badly that his nose was bruised and his face was swollen. He couldn't even scream before he fainted!Then, a rough laughter came from outside."Hahaha, Mr. Leng, why didn't you invite your brothers to join in the fun on your 70th birthday?!" The visitor carried a baseball bat on his shoulder, a cigarette in his mouth, and a ferocious green dragon tattooed on his arms and chest. The overall image was like a bearded man!Behind him, there were a dozen strong men of the same appearance!When the old man saw it, he was immediately surprised: "Who are you? What are you here for?!" The man sneered and looked at Sun Shaohua, "We are here to find someone to pay off our debts today. I'm afraid we have to disturb your birthday party, old man." The threat in his eyes made all the people who were arrogantly mocking Mingchuan become a little more timid.But at the same time, doubts arose in everyone's hearts.Who in the Leng family would owe money to such a gangster?No one is short of those three melons and two dates!At this time, no one except Mingchuan noticed that the previously domineering Sun Shaohua quietly and slowly retreated toward the rear the moment he saw the strong man.Mingchuan laughed secretly in his heart.The way I pretended to be Brother Bi just now, I'm afraid I'm going to overturn.Ren Xiaolan claimed to be an elder and stood up with dignity, "You must have made a mistake..." "Bang!" The strong man ignored him and picked up a stool and threw it in the direction Sun Shaohua left, smashing the table of food next to him to pieces!"You bitch, where do you want to run?" As the man finished speaking, a dozen strong men behind him immediately rushed forward and blocked Sun Shaohua's path without any gaps!Sun Shaohua's face suddenly showed a bit of panic.He hurriedly concealed his fear, turned around, raised a smile, and smiled at the man: "Brother Huang... Why do you have time to come here?" Brother Huang walked up with a stick in his arms, pinched Sun Shaohua's pretty face, and took several shots."What should I ask you then?"
